title: Kowalski-Untrau vacuity localizes the tool to an EFFECTIVE Jacobi-average MGF, not a Wasserstein bound (re-pointing F6/F7 onto the monodromy surface F19)
evidence: Two exact-arithmetic probes at PROPER-subgroup prize-like params (n=8,16,32,64; m=index>=8; many primes p=kn+1). scripts/probes/_407_conn/probe_C066_jacobi_mgf.py and probe_C066_structural.py. (1) The connection's TWO factual parts hold: KU's Wasserstein bound IS vacuous at prize scale (already axiom-clean in KowalskiUntrauBarrier.lean, ku_bound_vacuous_at_prize) and the SalemZygmund route DOES consume one MGF (chernoff_max_re_le, axiom-clean). But the load-bearing RELOCATION claim is FALSE. (2) STRUCTURAL DUALITY (probe_C066_structural S1, err=1e-12=machine zero): the operative object satisfies EXACTLY |T_h| = |A_h|/(m*sqrt(p)), where A_h is the DFT spectrum of |eta_b|^2 (identity I2). So the Jacobi-average family (|T_h|)_h IS the normalized power spectrum of the Gauss-period family (eta_b)_b -- same object, Fourier-dual, NOT a different 'monodromy surface'. (3) SAME GROWTH (probe S jacobi_mgf): max_h|T_h|/sqrt(n) tracks B/sqrt(n) across every (n,p); C_tangent = max|T_h|/sqrt(n ln m) tracks C_house = B/sqrt(n ln m) (ratio ~1: n=8 0.83->1.01, n=64 ~1.0-1.5). The Jacobi-average carries the IDENTICAL sqrt(n log m) BGK-wall growth, so controlling its MGF is controlling B = the BGK/Paley Gauss-period house. (4) WRONG DIRECTION: applying the SAME Lean SubGaussianMGF recipe, the eta_c family has bounded proxy_eta/n in [0.91,1.21] (the prize-supporting O(n) the route needs), but the T_h family has proxy_T/n that GROWS with n: ~1.4 (n=8), ~2.2-2.9 (n=16), ~3.4-4.9 (n=32), ~5.0-6.8 (n=64). The proposed substitute is STRICTLY STRONGER, not weaker. (5) LOSSY (S2): the natural l1-of-Jacobi bound B^2 <= sqrt(p)*L1(T)/m + n has looseness that GROWS with m toward the prize regime (1.0-1.5 at m~10-20, 2.2-2.9 at m~200) -- the triangle bound on the spectrum discards exactly the sqrt-cancellation among the m phases that is the entire BGK content.
honest_note: Refutes only the RELOCATION/weakening claim (that the needed object is strictly weaker than KU's Wasserstein and lives on F19 not BGK). The connection's two factual premises are correct and already in-tree: KU vacuity (KowalskiUntrauBarrier.lean) and the one-MGF chaining kernel (SalemZygmundChaining.lean). The refutation is: via the EXACT identity |T_h|=|A_h|/(m*sqrt(p)) (verified 1e-12), the Jacobi-average T_h is the Fourier dual of the same Gauss-period house, with the same sqrt(n log m) growth and a WORSE empirical MGF, so it welds straight back to the BGK/Paley wall rather than off it. The proper-subgroup, large-index (m up to ~300) probes avoid the #400 full-group trap. Not a Lean proof of the implication (the attack_plan's EffectiveJacobiAverageMGF => SubGaussianMGF), because the numerics show that implication does not buy a weaker hypothesis -- the antecedent is empirically harder than the consequent. Goes to DISPROOF_LOG as: 'Jacobi-average MGF substitute = Fourier-dual of the Gauss-period house = BGK wall (no relocation; substitute is strictly stronger).'
wall: W-BGK (the Bourgain-Glibichuk-Konyagin / Paley-graph sqrt-cancellation wall: max_h|T_h| is the exact Fourier dual of the Gauss-period house B, same sqrt(n log m) growth)
